दृगध्यक्ष m. (-क्षः) The sun.
 E. दृश् the sight, अध्यक्ष ruler.

दृग्गोल m. (-लः) A small circle on the axis of the earth, within the
greater circle of the armillary sphere, and accompanying each
planetary circle.
 E. दृश्, and गोल circle.

दृग्विष m. (-षः) A serpent or other such venomous reptile.
 E. दृश् eye,
and विष poison; whose eye is venomous.
